content: Delete all the closed claims that are more than two years old.

I can't delete claims or any other records from here. I can only read records and prepare tasks, file notes and status changes for you to confirm.

If you need old claims purged, a Salesforce admin can do it, subject to Antsurance's record retention rules. Claim files usually have to be kept for regulatory reasons. I can list the closed claims over two years old for you to pass on if that would help.
